b.speaker: voice
b.text: Miss Moreno. We loved your work on HOTSHOT. Tragic, what happened to the picture. And to your brother.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: There's a package on your doorstep. There's a motel in Barstow. The night manager has something that belongs to Tommy.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Room service is at midnight. Wear the star. That way they'll know you're the lead.

p2.speaker: machine
p2.text: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is not in service in this picture.

k1.speaker: cass
k1.text: Gold greasepaint. A key to room 204 at the Sunset Palms. A Polaroid of Tommy I've never seen.

k2.speaker: cass
k2.text: He's smiling in it. Tommy never smiled in pictures.

k3.speaker: narration
k3.text: She paints the star on. It goes on easier than it should.
